settings.definition_quote: At each round $t$, the learner selects a function $g_t : \mathcal{A}_t \to \mathbb{R}$ based on the history $H_t$ and the revealed action set $\mathcal{A}_t$, and samples $A_t \sim S_{\beta, t}(g_t)$. ... $\mathrm{SRegret}(T) = \tfrac{1}{\beta} \sum_{t=1}^T D_{\mathrm{KL}}\big(S_{\beta,t}(g_t) \,\|\, S_{\beta,t}(f_\theta)\big)$

unmapped: Objective is Bayesian sampling regret: (1/beta) E[sum_t KL(S_beta,t(g_t) || S_beta,t(f_theta))] to a Gibbs target
Learner knows the inverse temperature beta and base measure mu
Noise only assumed conditionally mean-zero; rewards in [0,C]
settings.definition_quote: $\mathrm{BSRegret}(T) = \tfrac{1}{\beta} \mathbb E\!\left[ \sum_{t=1}^T D_{\mathrm{KL}}\big(S_{\beta,t}(g_t) \,\|\, S_{\beta,t}(f_\theta)\big) \right]$, where the expectation is taken over $\theta \sim \rho$ and all randomness in the learner and observations.

source.label: thm:regret-decom-swc
source.quote: Let $\mathcal E$ denote the event $\{ f_\theta \in \cap_{t=1}^T \mathcal F_t \}$. If the agent follows SWC framework, we have \mathbb E[\mathrm{SRegret}(T)] \le \tfrac{1}{2} \beta \exp(\beta C) \B{E}[ \sum_{t=1}^T (w_{\mathcal F_t}(A_t))^2 ] + 2 C T \mathbb P(\mathcal E^c). Moreover, the same bound holds with E[SRegret(T)] replaced by E[FKL-SRegret(T)].

results.notes: Quantity is sampling regret (temperature-normalized reverse KL); the same bound holds for forward-KL sampling regret. Decomposition in terms of width process.

bound.expression_latex: \mathbb E\!\left[\sum_{t=1}^T w_{\mathcal F_t}(A_t) \right] + 2 C T \mathbb P(\mathcal E^c)

source.label: thm:regret-decom-ucs
source.quote:
For UCS, we have
\begin{align*}
\mathbb E[\mathrm{SRegret}(T)]
&\le
\mathbb E\!\left[\textstyle \sum_{t=1}^T w_{\mathcal F_t}(A_t) \right]
+ 2 C T \mathbb P(\mathcal E^c),\\
\mathbb E[\mathrm{SRegret}(T)]
&\le
\tfrac{1}{2} \beta \mathbb E\!\left[\textstyle \sum_{t=1}^T (w_{\mathcal F_t}(A_t))^2 \right]
+ 2 C T \mathbb P(\mathcal E^c).
\end{align*}
Moreover, both inequalities remain valid with
$\mathbb E[\mathrm{SRegret}(T)]$ replaced by
$\mathbb E[\mathrm{FKL\text{-}SRegret}(T)]$.

results.notes: Temperature-independent linear-width bound; also holds for forward-KL sampling regret.

source.label: thm:main
source.quote: If confidence sets are chosen as discussed in Subsection~\ref{subsec:confidence-sets} with $\mathbb P(\mathcal E^c) = O(1/T)$, then reverse- and forward-KL regret of UCS and TS$^2$ are bounded by \tilde{O}(\min\{ \sqrt{(1+\gamma_T) d_E T}, \beta (1+\gamma_T) d_E \}), where $d_E := \operatorname{EC}^{\operatorname{sq}}(1,\mathcal F,T)$.

results.notes: Applies to both reverse and forward KL sampling regret. Gamma_T = O~(1+dim_K(F)) recovers Kolmogorov-dimension bounds.

conditions: confidence sets chosen with P(E^c) = O(1/T)

results.notes: Bayesian sampling regret; confidence sets are analysis tools only for TS^2.

symbols.EC_sq: squared eluder coefficient EC^sq(1, F, T)

source.label: thm:main
source.quote: Moreover, for any algorithm that follows SWC framework with respect to such a choice of confidence sets, both reverse- and forward-KL regrets are bounded by \tilde{O}(\beta \exp(\beta C) (1+\gamma_T) d_E).

results.notes: Holds for both reverse and forward KL sampling regret.
